The podium of the most viewed videos in the world this week.

Full countdown, from 10 to 1: https://youtu.be/xkhc1zX8kJQ

Data from the official YouTube API. Synthetic voice narration. #Top10RS #shorts

escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in the world this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, MY FIRST DAY IN VICE CITY | GTA 6 GAMEPLAY, by Techno Gamerz, with over 36 million views.
In second place, Avengers: Doomsday | Final Trailer | In Theaters…, by Marvel Entertainment, with over 50 million views.
And number one: I Survived 100 Hours In GTA 6, by MrBeast Gaming, with over 72 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
